acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves explicit journey-to-test linkage; it does not prove the journey passed in production or was accepted by users.
evidenceRequired: Regression tests show that an unrelated generic E2E wrapper cannot link canonical journey proof.
A positive fixture links only explicitly named, existing test paths to the canonical journey.

completionCriteria: Journey proof is LINKED only when the canonical journey explicitly names an existing test or scenario path.
Generic E2E scripts, smoke wrappers, or unrelated browser tests cannot satisfy the journey-proof gate.
Missing, renamed, or stale journey test paths produce fragmented proof and keep design locked.
Reports distinguish test linkage from executed proof, rendered acceptance, hosted behavior, and production outcome.
nonObjectives: Do not create a second E2E hierarchy.
Do not infer linkage from script names or directory placement.
Do not promote local test linkage into production or human-acceptance proof.
objective: Bind journey readiness to explicit journey-owned proof instead of repository-wide E2E heuristics.
title: Bind canonical journeys to explicit proof
